title: 定义矩形类
problem_statement_md:
假设你正在编写绘图应用程序，已定义了形状基类`Shape`。
给出的代码需要定义矩形类`Rectangle`，并创建矩形类对象，然后调用其面积`area()`和周长`perimeter()`方法。

做到以下几点就可以完成这个程序。
- 矩形类`Rectangle`需要继承基类`Shape`。
- 在矩形类中定义周长`perimeter`方法，打印矩形的周长。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Inheritance[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a drawing application, which has a [b]Shape[/b] base class.
The given code defines a Rectangle class, creates a Rectangle object and calls its [b]area()[/b] and [b]perimeter()[/b] methods. 

Do the following to complete the program:
1. Inherit the [b]Rectangle[/b] class from [b]Shape[/b].
2. Define the [b]perimeter[/b]() method in the Rectangle class, printing the perimeter of the rectangle. 

[note]The perimeter is equal to [b]2*(width+height)[/b][/note]
